arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-pathpatch.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = c7996a41c22d99f52f25d4c12e793bb3b3a8917d
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('codex/scope_discovery.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='    if mentioned:\n        if len(mentioned) != 1:\n            return order\n'
new='''    # Reject mixed existing and missing explicit paths; never silently drop
    # an explicit file from a multi-file Owner instruction.
    explicit_paths = {m.group(0) for m in EXPLICIT_PATH_TOKEN.finditer(request)}
    if explicit_paths and (
        len(explicit_paths) != 1 or len(mentioned) != 1
        or next(iter(explicit_paths)) != mentioned[0]
    ):
        return order
    if mentioned:
        if len(mentioned) != 1:
            return order
'''
assert s.count(old)==1,'SOURCE_ANCHOR_DRIFT'
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
p=Path('codex/tests/test_scope_discovery.py')
s=p.read_text()
anchor='    def test_untracked_explicit_filename_cannot_fall_back_to_tests(self):\n'
addition='''    def test_existing_and_missing_explicit_paths_need_scoping(self):
        self._add_tracked_codex_files()
        order = dict(self.order,
                     request="Corrige codex/smart.py e codex/missing.py e executa os testes")
        self.assertNotIn("work_items", discover_work_items(order, self.repo))
        self.assertEqual(plan(order)["status"], "needs_scoping")

'''
assert s.count(anchor)==1,'TEST_ANCHOR_DRIFT'
p.write_text(s.replace(anchor,addition+anchor,1))
PY
python3 -m unittest codex.tests.test_scope_discovery -q
echo FOCUSED_MIXED_PATH_REGRESSION_PASS
python3 -m unittest discover -s codex/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q
echo FULL_CODEX_REGRESSION_PASS
git diff --check
test "$(git status --short | wc -l)" -eq 2
echo CHANGED_FILE_SHA256
sha256sum codex/scope_discovery.py codex/tests/test_scope_discovery.py
git --no-pager diff -- codex/scope_discovery.py codex/tests/test_scope_discovery.py
echo REA_SCOPE_PATCH_VALIDATED
